renderer: TOKEN_RENDERER — the Phase 4.2 token renderer (migrate/src/semantics/), 20 built-in codes, compared with displayMatches.
comparison: displayMatches — exact byte comparison outside item and parameter name spans, which the anonymised corpus (D-114) cannot supply and which unify with a back-reference instead. NOT plain string equality: 99.77% of corpus rows carry an anonymised name, so a === comparison caps at 4.60% weighted however correct the renderer is.
ceiling: About 96%. 917 rows (4.03%) were destroyed by the Phase 0.5 anonymiser and can never match — a private filter's Name is frequently its own DisplayFormula, so whole display strings were replaced wholesale. formula-decoder-spec.md §11.1 states the one-line fix.
note: A ratchet AND a gate. formula-corpus-agreement.test.ts fails if a change lowers either rate, and separately if either falls under phaseGate. Raise these by hand when a change lifts them, in the same commit that lifts them. Both rates are reported because they answer different questions: distinct is how much of the formula language is covered, weighted is how many real formulas in a real estate would render.
